findings.title: robots.txt blocks known AI/answer-engine crawlers: GPTBot
findings.evidence: can_fetch() returned False for ['GPTBot'] against http://127.0.0.1:8931/ per http://127.0.0.1:8931/robots.txt

suggested_action.summary: Remove or narrow the Disallow rules for these agents unless the block is intentional (e.g. paywalled/private content).
suggested_action.mechanism: A blocked crawler can't fetch the page at all — this isn't a ranking penalty, the content is architecturally invisible to that system regardless of quality.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod dates are stale sitewide
findings.evidence: Newest <lastmod> across 2 URLs is 2023-02-01 (1309 days old).

suggested_action.summary: Regenerate the sitemap so lastmod reflects real content changes.
Remove noindex from pages meant to be publicly discoverable.

findings.title: Rendered content is 40.0x larger than raw HTML at http://127.0.0.1:8931/app/
findings.evidence: Raw GET: 1 words. Headless render: 40 words.

suggested_action.summary: Server-render or prerender this route so key content ships in the initial HTML response.
suggested_action.mechanism: Fetchers that don't execute JavaScript — most AI-answer-engine crawlers included — only ever see the raw response. If the facts only exist after render, they don't exist for those systems.

findings.title: No <nav> element found
findings.evidence: No <nav> tag in http://127.0.0.1:8931/.; No <nav> tag in http://127.0.0.1:8931/product/.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap primary navigation in a <nav> element with descriptive link text.

findings.title: No mobile viewport meta tag
findings.evidence: No <meta name="viewport"> found on http://127.0.0.1:8931/.; No <meta name="viewport"> found on http://127.0.0.1:8931/product/.

findings.title: No contact/about link found
findings.evidence: No link containing 'contact' or 'about' found on http://127.0.0.1:8931/.; No link containing 'contact' or 'about' found on http://127.0.0.1:8931/product/.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible link to a contact or about page from primary navigation.

findings.title: Page implies FAQPage content but has no FAQPage structured data
findings.evidence: Content-based signal detected for FAQPage (e.g. price pattern or FAQ-shaped headings) but @type=FAQPage absent from JSON-LD on http://127.0.0.1:8931/product/. Types actually present: ['Organization'].; Content-based signal detected for Product (e.g. price pattern or FAQ-shaped headings) but @type=Product absent from JSON-LD on http://127.0.0.1:8931/product/. Types actually present: ['Organization'].

suggested_action.summary: Add FAQPage JSON-LD matching what the page already says in prose.
suggested_action.mechanism: Structured data is what an assistant quotes from directly; prose alone requires the extractor to correctly parse free text, which is far less reliable.

findings.title: Organization structured data is present but missing required properties

suggested_action.summary: Fill in the missing required Organization properties.

findings.title: 1 image(s) likely carrying facts have no alt text
findings.evidence: Images with no alt text and filenames suggesting factual content: ['/images/price-chart.png']

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text (or a plain-text equivalent nearby) restating the key facts the image carries.

findings.title: Key facts appear to live only inside a linked PDF
findings.evidence: PDF links whose href/anchor text suggest primary facts live there, with no on-page text equivalent found: ['/docs/pricing-sheet.pdf']

suggested_action.summary: Mirror the PDF's key facts as plain HTML text on the page itself; keep the PDF as a download option, not the only copy.
suggested_action.mechanism: Most fetchers extract page text directly; a fact that requires opening and parsing a separate PDF is far less likely to be read and used at all.

findings.title: Evergreen-sounding claims on a page whose newest date signal is 1326 days old
findings.evidence: http://127.0.0.1:8931/about/: phrasing matched an evergreen-claim pattern (e.g. 'currently', 'we are') with no 'as of' qualifier nearby; newest date signal found on the page is 2023-01-15 (1326 days old).

suggested_action.summary: Either refresh the content and its date, or add an explicit 'as of <date>' qualifier so the claim doesn't read as current when it may not be.
suggested_action.mechanism: Assistants weight recency when deciding what to trust and repeat; an undated evergreen claim next to old date signals reads as unreliable once cross-checked.

findings.title: 1 internal link(s) lead to dead ends

suggested_action.summary: Fix or remove these internal links.
Reduce to a single <h1>; demote the rest to <h2>+.
